selected_evidence.requirement: Filesystem-level 100MB quota configured for datauser under /srv/data
selected_evidence.summary: xfs_quota limit set bsoft=100m bhard=100m for datauser on /srv/data (XFS loopback mount with usrquota), confirmed via report showing 100M/100M limits

selected_evidence.requirement: Quota is enforced by the kernel/filesystem itself (not just tracked)
selected_evidence.summary: datauser wrote 90MB successfully; a further 20MB write failed mid-write with kernel error 'Disk quota exceeded' at exactly 100MB used, confirmed by xfs_quota report

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline of boot identity and quota-enforced service/data
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 9094f607-..., uptime start, and confirmed /srv/data mounted with usrquota and Accounting/Enforcement ON before restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded `shutdown -r now` returned ACK_REBOOT_ISSUED to the exec caller before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node actually went down and came back (changed boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: SSH connection refused during reboot, then exec available again; boot_id changed to fe64b2f3-... and uptime start time advanced, proving an actual reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of the quota-enforced mount and data
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, /srv/data auto-remounted via fstab with usrquota, Accounting/Enforcement ON, datauser's 100M/100M limit intact; write test again failed with Disk quota exceeded at 100MB, then cleaned up leaving quota at 0/100M
